excluded_tables.chatbot_audit_log: internal AI audit trail (not business data)

modules.accounting: Chart of accounts, parties (retailers/suppliers/staff), ledgers, vouchers, bank deposits.
modules.inventory: Products, batches (live stock), categories, companies/brands, units, offers.
modules.sales_purchase: Sales/Purchase/Receipt/Credit-Debit note vouchers and their line items, GST.
modules.orders: Retailer app orders, order lines, carts, credit periods, field sales visits.
modules.finance_expenses: Staff expenses, bank statement deposits, P&L inputs.

accounts.description: Party master: retailers (customers), suppliers, staff, admin and ledger accounts. role identifies the party type.

group.description: Ledger group label (reserved word: always back-quote as `group`).

status.description: Account status; observed values '1' and 'Active' both mean active.

opening_balance.description: Opening ledger balance; direction in opening_balance_type (Debit/Credit).

unpaid_amount.description: Running outstanding receivable for the party (maintained by voucher routes).

is_dual_account.description: 1 when a supplier is also a retailer.

batches.description: Product batches holding LIVE stock. quantity is the running on-hand stock, mutated by every stock-in (Purchase/CreditNote/stock inward) and stock-out (Sales/DebitNote/stock transfer).

exp_date.description: Expiry date stored as VARCHAR (YYYY-MM-DD); use STR_TO_DATE(exp_date, '%Y-%m-%d').

quantity.description: Current on-hand stock for the batch.

company_info.description: Tenant's own legal entity details (single row).

direct_deposit.description: Imported bank statement lines, reconciled to Receipt vouchers.

expensive.description: Staff operating expenses (table name is a legacy typo of 'expenses'). No primary key.

orders.description: Retailer app orders (header). Invoiced orders have invoice_status = 1.

net_payable.description: Final payable amount for the order (used for retailer purchase totals).

products.description: Product master. purchase_price (INT) is the costing basis for COGS.

goods_name.description: Product name; production COGS joins voucherdetails.product = products.goods_name.

unit.description: Mostly units.id as text; occasionally a literal like 'pcs'.

sales_visits.description: Field sales staff visits to retailers.

voucher.description: Universal voucher header: Sales, Purchase, Receipt, Payment, CreditNote, DebitNote, Journal, Contra, stock transfer, stock inward, purchase voucher, Production, Consumption.

TransactionType.description: Voucher type. Compare case-insensitively; 'Stock Transfer' = KACHA sale.

TotalAmount.description: Grand total incl. GST (revenue basis for Sales).

L_I.description: local / interstate supply (drives CGST+SGST vs IGST).

voucherdetails.description: Voucher line items (product, batch, qty, price, GST split).

allowed_joins.alias_hint: Use a distinct alias (e.g. acc) when joining accounts twice.

status is ENUM('Pending','Partial','Paid'); production P&L still applies the NOT IN ('Cancelled','canceled') filter. Keep it verbatim for reconciliation.
Backend writes 'stock transfer' and reads 'Stock Transfer'; collation utf8mb4_general_ci makes = comparisons case-insensitive. Never use BINARY comparisons.
Table has no PK; use COUNT(*) rather than COUNT(DISTINCT id) for expense counts.
Use STR_TO_DATE(b.exp_date, '%Y-%m-%d') for expiry comparisons.
Back-quote reserved column names: accounts.`group`, expensive.`date`, voucher.`Date`.

business_rules: Sales revenue = voucher.TransactionType = 'Sales' (PAKKA). 'stock transfer' vouchers are KACHA sales and are EXCLUDED from P&L revenue unless the user explicitly asks for kacha/stock-transfer sales.
Stock-IN types: Purchase, CreditNote, stock inward. Stock-OUT types: Sales, DebitNote, stock transfer (VochurRoutes.js L1298).
Sales returns = CreditNote vouchers; purchase returns = DebitNote vouchers.
Retailers are accounts.role = 'retailer' (dual suppliers have is_dual_account = 1).
Retailer purchase value = SUM(orders.net_payable) WHERE order_status != 'Cancelled' AND invoice_status = 1 (retailerScore.js).
Indian financial year runs 1 April - 31 March; 'this FY' means DATE(v.Date) BETWEEN 'YYYY-04-01' AND 'YYYY+1-03-31'.

total_sales_revenue.description: Gross sales revenue: sum of Sales voucher TotalAmount excluding cancelled.
filters: (v.status NOT IN ('Cancelled', 'canceled') OR v.status IS NULL OR v.status = '')
total_sales_revenue.canonical_sql: SELECT COALESCE(SUM(v.TotalAmount), 0) AS total_sales_revenue, COUNT(v.VoucherID) AS sales_invoice_count FROM voucher v WHERE v.TransactionType = 'Sales' AND (v.status NOT IN ('Cancelled', 'canceled') OR v.status IS NULL OR v.status = '') AND DATE(v.Date) BETWEEN '{from_date}' AND '{to_date}'

cost_of_goods_sold.description: COGS: quantity sold x products.purchase_price, joined by product NAME as in production.
filters: (v.status NOT IN ('Cancelled', 'canceled') OR v.status IS NULL OR v.status = '')
cost_of_goods_sold.canonical_sql: SELECT COALESCE(SUM(vd.quantity * COALESCE(p.purchase_price, 0)), 0) AS cost_of_goods_sold, COALESCE(SUM(vd.quantity), 0) AS total_units_sold FROM voucherdetails vd JOIN voucher v ON v.VoucherID = vd.voucher_id LEFT JOIN products p ON p.goods_name = vd.product WHERE v.TransactionType = 'Sales' AND (v.status NOT IN ('Cancelled', 'canceled') OR v.status IS NULL OR v.status = '') AND vd.transaction_type = 'Sales' AND DATE(v.Date) BETWEEN '{from_date}' AND '{to_date}'

total_expenses.description: Operating expenses from the expensive table excluding cancelled.
filters: (e.status NOT IN ('Cancelled', 'canceled') OR e.status IS NULL OR e.status = '')
total_expenses.canonical_sql: SELECT COALESCE(SUM(e.amount), 0) AS total_expenses, COUNT(*) AS expense_count FROM expensive e WHERE (e.status NOT IN ('Cancelled', 'canceled') OR e.status IS NULL OR e.status = '') AND DATE(e.`date`) BETWEEN '{from_date}' AND '{to_date}'

gross_profit.canonical_sql: WITH sales AS (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(v.TotalAmount), 0) AS total_sales_revenue, COUNT(v.VoucherID) AS sales_invoice_count FROM voucher v WHERE v.TransactionType = 'Sales' AND (v.status NOT IN ('Cancelled', 'canceled') OR v.status IS NULL OR v.status = '') AND DATE(v.Date) BETWEEN '{from_date}' AND '{to_date}'), cogs AS (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(vd.quantity * COALESCE(p.purchase_price, 0)), 0) AS cost_of_goods_sold, COALESCE(SUM(vd.quantity), 0) AS total_units_sold FROM voucherdetails vd JOIN voucher v ON v.VoucherID = vd.voucher_id LEFT JOIN products p ON p.goods_name = vd.product WHERE v.TransactionType = 'Sales' AND (v.status NOT IN ('Cancelled', 'canceled') OR v.status IS NULL OR v.status = '') AND vd.transaction_type = 'Sales' AND DATE(v.Date) BETWEEN '{from_date}' AND '{to_date}') SELECT s.total_sales_revenue, c.cost_of_goods_sold, s.total_sales_revenue - c.cost_of_goods_sold AS gross_profit FROM sales s CROSS JOIN cogs c

net_profit.description: Net profit = gross_profit - total_expenses (positive = PROFIT, negative = LOSS).
net_profit.canonical_sql: WITH sales AS (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(v.TotalAmount), 0) AS total_sales_revenue, COUNT(v.VoucherID) AS sales_invoice_count FROM voucher v WHERE v.TransactionType = 'Sales' AND (v.status NOT IN ('Cancelled', 'canceled') OR v.status IS NULL OR v.status = '') AND DATE(v.Date) BETWEEN '{from_date}' AND '{to_date}'), cogs AS (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(vd.quantity * COALESCE(p.purchase_price, 0)), 0) AS cost_of_goods_sold, COALESCE(SUM(vd.quantity), 0) AS total_units_sold FROM voucherdetails vd JOIN voucher v ON v.VoucherID = vd.voucher_id LEFT JOIN products p ON p.goods_name = vd.product WHERE v.TransactionType = 'Sales' AND (v.status NOT IN ('Cancelled', 'canceled') OR v.status IS NULL OR v.status = '') AND vd.transaction_type = 'Sales' AND DATE(v.Date) BETWEEN '{from_date}' AND '{to_date}'), expenses AS (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(e.amount), 0) AS total_expenses, COUNT(*) AS expense_count FROM expensive e WHERE (e.status NOT IN ('Cancelled', 'canceled') OR e.status IS NULL OR e.status = '') AND DATE(e.`date`) BETWEEN '{from_date}' AND '{to_date}') SELECT s.total_sales_revenue, c.cost_of_goods_sold, s.total_sales_revenue - c.cost_of_goods_sold AS gross_profit, x.total_expenses, s.total_sales_revenue - c.cost_of_goods_sold - x.total_expenses AS net_profit FROM sales s CROSS JOIN cogs c CROSS JOIN expenses x

party_unpaid_balance.description: Outstanding receivable per party from accounts.unpaid_amount (VARCHAR -> DECIMAL).
party_unpaid_balance.canonical_sql: SELECT a.id, a.name, a.business_name, a.role, COALESCE(CAST(a.unpaid_amount AS DECIMAL(15,2)), 0) AS party_unpaid_balance, a.credit_limit FROM accounts a WHERE CAST(a.unpaid_amount AS DECIMAL(15,2)) > 0 ORDER BY party_unpaid_balance DESC
party_unpaid_balance.alternative: Invoice-level: SUM(v.balance_amount) FROM voucher v WHERE v.TransactionType = 'Sales' GROUP BY v.PartyID (retailerScore.js L929-L941).

total_purchases.description: Purchase voucher totals (reference only; NOT used as COGS).
filters: (v.status NOT IN ('Cancelled', 'canceled') OR v.status IS NULL OR v.status = '')
total_purchases.canonical_sql: SELECT COALESCE(SUM(v.TotalAmount), 0) AS total_purchases, COUNT(v.VoucherID) AS purchase_invoice_count FROM voucher v WHERE v.TransactionType = 'Purchase' AND (v.status NOT IN ('Cancelled', 'canceled') OR v.status IS NULL OR v.status = '') AND DATE(v.Date) BETWEEN '{from_date}' AND '{to_date}'

batch_stock_on_hand.description: Live on-hand stock and cost valuation per batch (VARCHAR stock/cost columns cast).
batch_stock_on_hand.canonical_sql: SELECT p.goods_name, b.batch_number, b.exp_date, CAST(b.quantity AS DECIMAL(15,2)) AS stock_on_hand, CAST(b.quantity AS DECIMAL(15,2)) * CAST(b.purchase_price AS DECIMAL(15,2)) AS stock_value FROM batches b JOIN products p ON p.id = b.product_id ORDER BY p.goods_name, b.batch_number
